body.p: Two deer Once lived Aivacedo. They had two deer: an old stag and an old stag. One day a wild deer approached them outside and said to the lady: âCome with me! Let's go to the high hills. Here, among people, mosquitoes, midges, gadflies will eat your antlers, gnaw them. The gadfly will perforate your skin, the smokers will blacken your skin. There are no smokers on the high hills, because there are no mosquitoes, midges and gadflies. There your horns will come to life, your wool will shine from good food. Wool revives, come with me. Then the domestic deer said to him: âI wonât go with you, I will live here on the forest capes. My owner lives nearby and guards me. I sleep peacefully, I'm not afraid of anyone. Like you in a snow pit, bleeding, I donât want to lie down, just like you donât want to fall into the teeth of a wolf. After these words, the doe remained with her master. And the wild deer went to the high hills. Until now, Aivacedo lives with deer, they are guarded. And wild deer live without people, on high hills. Here is the end.
